description: T-1745 probe: for each in-domain BETA.INV sweep point (m9-beta-inv, m9-legacy-betainv), Excel's result x (column E, from the oracle) and its neighbouring doubles (D, F) as constants, BETA.DIST(.,a,b,TRUE) of each (G-I), and BETA.INV again from constant inputs (J). Shows whether Excel's quantile is the crossing point of its own CDF.
